segments.text:
V. 23.
The brethren—That is, the Chriſtians. Our LORD Himſelf taught them that Appellation, ch. xx. 17. Yet Jeſus did not ſay to him, That he ſhould not die—Not expreſsly. And St. John himſelf, at the Time of writing his Goſpel, ſeems not to have known clearly, whether he ſhould die or not.
